message.content:
This screenshot displays the **Vercel Dashboard**, specifically the **Integrations** page for a project named **"rtr360"**. This is a web application interface used for managing cloud deployments and third-party service connections.

## **Overall Layout & Context**

The interface uses a **dark theme** (black/dark gray background with white text) and is displayed within a Google Chrome browser window on a Windows operating system (visible taskbar at bottom). The URL shows: `vercel.com/rtr-dd4d1e8e/rtr360/settings/integrations`

---

## **Top Navigation Bar**

**Browser Elements (Chrome):**
- Tab bar showing multiple open tabs including Gmail, Vercel, "RTR 360 — Fleet Technology", and an active "Ask Gemini" tab
- Address bar with the current URL
- Standard browser controls (back/forward, refresh, bookmark star, profile icon)

**Vercel Header:**
- **Left side:** Project selector showing "RTR" (with green "Hobby" plan badge) and dropdown arrow
- **Center:** Project name "rtr360" with Vercel logo (green triangle)
- **Right side:** 
  - "Integrations" breadcrumb/link
  - "Agent" button with grid icon

---

## **Left Sidebar Navigation**

A vertical navigation menu with the following items (top to bottom):

1. **Search bar** - "Find" with keyboard shortcut "F"
2. **Overview** (with green dashboard icon) - currently highlighted/selected
3. **Deployments** (box icon)
4. **Logs** (list icon)
5. **Analytics** (chart icon)
6. **Speed Insights** (gauge icon)
7. **Observability** (eye icon) - with expand arrow (>)
8. **Firewall** (shield icon) - with expand arrow (>)
9. **CDN** (globe icon) - with expand arrow (>)
10. **Environment Variables** (sliders icon)
11. **Domains** (link icon)
12. **Connect** (plug icon) - with blue "Beta" badge
13. **Integrations** (puzzle piece icon) - **currently selected/active item** (highlighted in dark gray)
14. **Storage** (database icon)
15. **Flags** (flag icon) - with expand arrow (>)
16. **Agent** (sparkles icon) - with expand arrow (>)
17. **AI Gateway** (network icon) - with expand arrow (>)
18. **Sandboxes** (container icon) - with expand arrow (>)
19. **Workflows** (nodes icon)
20. **Images** (image icon) - with blue "Beta" badge
21. **Usage** (clock icon)
22. **Support** (life preserver icon)

**Bottom of sidebar:** User account "creatorshubconfid..." with notification bell icon

---

## **Main Content Area - Integrations Page**

### **Header Section**
- **Title:** "Integrations" (large bold text)
- **Subtitle:** "Connect your Vercel Project with third-party services to automate aspects of your workflow"
- **Action Buttons (top right):**
  - "Integrations Console" (dark button)
  - "Browse Marketplace" (white/light button)

### **Search & Filter Bar**
- **Search input:** "Search integrations" with search icon and "/" keyboard shortcut indicator
- **Dropdown filter:** "All Installed integrations" with dropdown arrow

### **Installed Integration Card**
One integration is currently installed:

**Supabase**
- **Icon:** Green lightning bolt logo
- **Badge:** Green "Billed Via Vercel" label
- **Category:** "Authentication"
- **Status:** "Updated 13h ago" with green checkmark circle
- **Action:** "Manage" button (dark outlined)

---

## **Right Sidebar - Latest Integrations Marketplace**

A panel titled **"Latest Integrations"** with subtitle "Explore more integrations to expand your Vercel development experience."

List of available integrations (each with icon, name, and description):

1. **LaunchDarkty** (rocket icon) - "Feature flags, experimentation, and AI AgentControl to ship with confidence."

2. **Exa** (blue X icon) - "AI-powered search API for developers. Build smarter apps with webia search."

3. **Algolia** (blue A icon) - "Immediately show users what they want with AI-driven results that convert."

4. **Endform** (colorful bars icon) - "Run your Playwright end to end tests in seconds."

5. **AgentMall** (robot head icon) - "Agentic email inboxes for AI agents. Send and receive at a scale of millions."

6. **MotherDuck** (orange duck icon) - "The serverless backend for analytics"

7. **Resend** (partially visible at bottom)

---

## **System Tray / Taskbar (Windows)**

Visible at the very bottom:
- **Left:** Weather widget showing "37°C Sunny", date "15/08/2026", time "13:19"
- **Center:** Windows Start button, Search box, pinned applications (File Explorer, Edge, Chrome, etc.)
- **Right:** System icons (ENG UK keyboard, WiFi, volume, battery), notification area

---

## **Summary**

This is the **Vercel project management dashboard** showing that the user has **one integration installed (Supabase for Authentication)** and is browsing available marketplace integrations to add more third-party services to their "rtr360" deployment project. The interface indicates this is a Hobby plan account, and the user is currently viewing the settings/integrations section of their project configuration.
